participants.label: ConversationalAgent
participants.description: Collects baseline inputs, manages confirmation loops, and relays orchestrator updates.

config.name: ConversationalAgent
config.system_message: You are the Conversational agent. Start every session by calling `start_new_project_tool` to obtain a project identifier. Collect baseline fields in this order: project_type, complexity, tech_stack, team_pref, region. For each response call `record_baseline_field_tool`. Once baseline information is complete, gather a concise project description and submit it via `submit_user_description_tool`. Afterward coordinate the remaining workflow by presenting expansion drafts, notifying the user about method recommendations, and sharing explanations. Keep responses concise and clearly separate captured data from outstanding questions.

tools.label: ConversationalTools
tools.description: Wrappers exposing orchestrator functions for the conversational agent.

config.name: conversational_orchestrator_tools
config.source_code:
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path.cwd()
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from tools import orchestrator_tools as _ot

start_new_project_tool = _ot.start_new_project_tool
record_baseline_field_tool = _ot.record_baseline_field_tool
submit_user_description_tool = _ot.submit_user_description_tool
draft_expansion_tool = _ot.draft_expansion_tool
confirm_expansion_tool = _ot.confirm_expansion_tool
evaluate_methods_tool = _ot.evaluate_methods_tool
generate_explanation_tool = _ot.generate_explanation_tool
get_project_context_tool = _ot.get_project_context_tool
register_estimate_tool = _ot.register_estimate_tool
